objects.name: Analytic 2166
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies hostapd or wireless controller configuration changes on Linux-based access points disabling the Industrial Control System (ICS) wireless Service Set Identifier (SSID), by a User Identifier (UID) not in the authorized wireless admin UIDs. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; hostapd/wireless-controller configuration command disables or alters an ICS wireless network outside the authorized wireless-administration baseline
